exposure: Establishment of a multidisciplinary team for rapid management of critical postpartum haemorrhage (PPH) cases (leveraging trauma team experience)
outcome: Process-related quality indicators (e.g., tranexamic acid use, time to first blood transfusion, arrival in operating room within 60 min)
cohort: The study participants were 71 critically ill postpartum haemorrhage (PPH) patients transferred from obstetric clinics to a tertiary care centre.
finding: The establishment of a multidisciplinary PPH team, leveraging trauma team expertise, significantly improved process-related and clinical outcomes for critically ill transferred PPH patients.
